boundary.actual_coordinate_definition: coordinates + lift + fluctuation; millimetres; scale one
boundary.method: Unsigned Euclidean distances of actual straight Q1 outer edges; no signed penetration

all_exposed.intersection_semantics: Crossing or raw zero-distance touch/overlap; positive roundoff near-touch is separate

boundary.circle_representation: native cell staircase; no analytic circle fit

boundary_intersections.intersection_semantics: Crossing or raw zero-distance touch/overlap; positive roundoff near-touch is separate

regions.projection_gap_definition: max(minA,minB)-min(maxA,maxB) on each unit edge-normal; mm; not penetration depth
regions.boundary_scope: Topologically exposed closed-region edges including any symmetry cut; self-overlap not tested; not physical contact boundaries

scope: Actual Q1 boundary distance and cross-cell interior overlap only; complete set containment and mechanism self-overlap not tested
